seo_title: Directions & Meeting Points | Find Your Tour Starting Location
seo_description: Find your Simply Enak tour meeting point in Kuala Lumpur or Penang. Directions, landmarks, parking info, and public transport options for every tour.
hero_description: Find your meeting point and get ready for an authentic Malaysian food adventure. All locations are central, safe, and easy to reach.

meeting_points.tour: Navigate Malaysia's Vegetarian Scene Like a Local
meeting_points.directions: Meet at the Oriental Building near Pasar Seni. Your guide will share the exact meeting point after booking.
meeting_points.landmark: Oriental Building — near Pasar Seni and Central Market
meeting_points.parking_info: Paid parking available at nearby shopping malls and public car parks.
meeting_points.public_transport: Accessible via MRT/LRT. Your guide will send the exact station exit before the tour.

meeting_points.directions: Take a Grab or taxi to Pudu Jail Gate (the old prison gate on Jalan Hang Tuah). It's the last remaining gate of the British-era prison. Your guide will be waiting there.
meeting_points.landmark: Pudu Jail Gate — historic prison gate on Jalan Hang Tuah
meeting_points.parking_info: Paid parking available at nearby shopping malls and public car parks.
meeting_points.public_transport: Accessible via MRT/LRT. Your guide will send the exact station exit before the tour.

meeting_points.tour: Secrets of KL - Nightlife, Street Art & Cocktails!
meeting_points.directions: Take the MRT to Pasar Seni station. Exit at Entrance A and your guide will be waiting there. The station connects directly to Chinatown.
meeting_points.landmark: Pasar Seni MRT Station — gateway to Chinatown and Merdeka Square
meeting_points.parking_info: Paid parking available at nearby shopping malls and public car parks.
meeting_points.public_transport: Accessible via MRT/LRT. Your guide will send the exact station exit before the tour.

meeting_points.directions: From the ferry terminal or Komtar, take a short Grab ride to Penang Road. MYDIN Emporium is a well-known landmark — your driver will know it. Your guide will be waiting near the main entrance.
meeting_points.landmark: MYDIN Emporium — a large department store on Penang Road
meeting_points.parking_info: Paid street parking available nearby. MYDIN Emporium has a parking lot.
meeting_points.public_transport: Grab or taxi from anywhere in George Town — approximately 10-15 minutes.

meeting_points.directions: Take the LRT to Pasar Seni station (Kelana Jaya Line). Exit at the main entrance and look for Tealive — your guide will be waiting there. Alternatively, take a Grab to Pasar Seni LRT.
meeting_points.landmark: Pasar Seni LRT Station — next to Central Market and Petaling Street
meeting_points.parking_info: Paid parking available at nearby shopping malls and public car parks.
meeting_points.public_transport: Accessible via MRT/LRT. Your guide will send the exact station exit before the tour.

meeting_points.directions: Take a Grab or taxi to Hilton Garden Inn North, Jalan Tuanku Abdul Rahman. The hotel entrance faces the main road. Your guide will meet you in the lobby area.
meeting_points.landmark: Hilton Garden Inn North — between Masjid India and Chow Kit
meeting_points.parking_info: Paid parking available at nearby shopping malls and public car parks.
meeting_points.public_transport: Accessible via MRT/LRT. Your guide will send the exact station exit before the tour.

meeting_points.tour: Georgetown's Best Hawkers and the Durian Strip
meeting_points.location_name: Sun Yat-Sen "Memorial Centre" at 65, Jalan Macalister
meeting_points.address: Sun Yat-Sen "Memorial Centre" at 65, Jalan Macalister
meeting_points.directions: Take a Grab to the Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Centre at 65 Jalan Macalister. This is a well-known colonial building. Your guide will be waiting at the entrance.
meeting_points.landmark: Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Centre — colonial building on Jalan Macalister
meeting_points.parking_info: Paid street parking available nearby. MYDIN Emporium has a parking lot.
meeting_points.public_transport: Grab or taxi from anywhere in George Town — approximately 10-15 minutes.

general_tips.tip: All meeting points are accessible via Grab (Southeast Asia's Uber). Download the app before your trip.
Your guide will send a WhatsApp message the day before your tour with the exact meeting point and their contact number.
If you're running late, message your guide directly on WhatsApp. They'll wait for you.
The KL tours are within walking distance of LRT/MRT stations. Penang tours are best reached by Grab.
Most meeting points have nearby cafes where you can wait with a drink before the tour starts.
If you can't find your guide, message the Simply Enak WhatsApp line at +60 17-287 8929.
